source: Compiled from Indian American Impact (iaimpact.org), Wikipedia, news sources, and official government websites
notes: Covers Indian-origin and South Asian-American elected officials and candidates across all levels of US government. Some local officials may have limited biographical information. Status values: elected (currently serving), appointed (executive appointment), candidate (running in 2026), former (no longer serving).

representatives.name: Ami Bera
representatives.bio: Physician and longest-serving Indian-American in Congress. Born in Los Angeles to Indian immigrant parents from Punjab. Represents Sacramento County area. Member of House Foreign Affairs Committee. Previously served as chief medical officer for Sacramento County.

representatives.name: Ro Khanna
representatives.bio: Represents Silicon Valley (Fremont, Cupertino, Santa Clara). Progressive voice in Congress focused on technology policy and economic populism. Parents immigrated from Punjab, India. Yale-educated lawyer. Author of 'Dignity in a Digital Age.'

representatives.name: Raja Krishnamoorthi
representatives.bio: Born in New Delhi, India; immigrated to the US as an infant. Princeton and Harvard Law School graduate. Ranking Member of the House Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party. Focused on technology policy, national security, and economic opportunity.

representatives.name: Pramila Jayapal
representatives.bio: First Indian-American woman elected to the U.S. House of Representatives. Born in Chennai, India; immigrated to the US at age 16. Chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus. Immigration and civil rights advocate. Previously served in the Washington State Senate.

representatives.name: Shri Thanedar
representatives.bio: Represents Detroit and surrounding areas. Born in Belgaum, India. Scientist-turned-entrepreneur who built multiple businesses before entering politics. First Indian-American elected to Congress from Michigan. Previously served in the Michigan House.

representatives.name: Suhas Subramanyam
representatives.bio: First Indian-American elected to Congress from Virginia and the East Coast. Previously served as a Virginia State Senator. Former White House advisor under President Obama. Hindu by faith. Lives in Ashburn, Virginia with his wife and two daughters.

representatives.name: Usha Vance
representatives.position: Second Lady of the United States
representatives.bio: First Indian-American Second Lady of the United States. Born Usha Chilukuri in San Diego County to Telugu Indian immigrant parents from Andhra Pradesh. Yale University and Yale Law School graduate. Former law clerk to Chief Justice John Roberts. Wife of Vice President JD Vance.

representatives.name: Kash Patel
representatives.position: Director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI)
representatives.bio: First Indian-American FBI Director. Confirmed by the Senate 51-49 in February 2025. Parents are Gujarati Indian immigrants. Previously served as Chief of Staff at the Department of Defense, Deputy Director of National Intelligence, and Senior Director for Counterterrorism at the NSC. Started career as a public defender in Miami-Dade.

representatives.name: Kamala Harris
representatives.position: Former Vice President of the United States; Former U.S. Senator, CA
representatives.bio: First Indian-American (and first Black and first female) Vice President of the United States (2021-2025). Mother Shyamala Gopalan was a Tamil Indian immigrant and cancer researcher. Previously served as U.S. Senator from California and Attorney General of California. 2024 Democratic presidential nominee.

representatives.name: Nikki Haley
representatives.position: Former Governor of South Carolina; Former U.S. Ambassador to the UN
representatives.bio: Born Nimrata Nikki Randhawa to Sikh Indian immigrant parents from Amritsar, Punjab. Second Indian-American governor in US history (2011-2017). Served as U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations (2017-2018). 2024 Republican presidential primary candidate.

representatives.name: Bobby Jindal
representatives.bio: First Indian-American governor in US history (2008-2016). Born Piyush Jindal in Baton Rouge to Indian immigrant parents from Punjab. Previously served in the U.S. House of Representatives (2005-2008). Rhodes Scholar. 2016 Republican presidential candidate.

representatives.name: Aruna Miller
representatives.bio: First South Asian woman elected lieutenant governor in the United States. Born Aruna Katragadda in Hyderabad, India (Andhra Pradesh); immigrated to the US at age 7. Civil engineer by profession. Previously served in the Maryland House of Delegates (2010-2019). Serves alongside Governor Wes Moore.

representatives.name: Ghazala Hashmi
representatives.bio: 43rd Lieutenant Governor of Virginia since January 2026. First Indian-American, first South Asian American, and first Muslim elected to statewide office in Virginia. First Muslim woman to win statewide office in the United States. Born in Hyderabad, India. PhD in English from Emory University. Previously served in the Virginia State Senate (2020-2026). Serves alongside Governor Abigail Spanberger.

representatives.name: Vivek Ramaswamy
representatives.position: Republican Nominee for Governor of Ohio
representatives.bio: Biotech entrepreneur and 2024 Republican presidential candidate running for Governor of Ohio in 2026. Son of Indian immigrants from Kerala. Founded Roivant Sciences. Former co-head of DOGE. Race rated as toss-up by Cook Political Report against Democrat Amy Acton.

representatives.name: Zohran Mamdani
representatives.bio: Mayor of New York City since January 1, 2026. Son of Indian filmmaker Mira Nair ('Monsoon Wedding') and Ugandan academic Mahmood Mamdani. Previously served in the New York State Assembly. Democratic socialist who defeated Andrew Cuomo in the Democratic primary. Ran on rent freeze, free public transit, and free childcare. Born in Uganda, raised in New York.

representatives.name: Aftab Pureval
representatives.bio: First Asian-American mayor of Cincinnati. Mother is a Tibetan immigrant from India. Father is of Indian Punjabi descent. Previously served as Hamilton County Clerk of Courts. Elected mayor in 2021.

representatives.name: Raj Salwan
representatives.bio: Mayor of Fremont, California. Indian-American community leader in the Bay Area's large South Asian community.

representatives.name: Sam Joshi
representatives.bio: Mayor of Edison, New Jersey, one of the largest Indian-American communities in the United States.

representatives.name: Danny Avula
representatives.bio: Mayor of Richmond, Virginia. Indian-American physician and public health leader. Previously led Virginia's COVID-19 vaccine distribution effort.

representatives.name: Sumbul Siddiqui
representatives.bio: First Muslim mayor of Cambridge, Massachusetts. South Asian-American community leader. Elected via City Council selection.

representatives.name: Nikil Saval
representatives.bio: Pennsylvania State Senator. Indian-American progressive legislator. Former editor of literary magazine n+1. Focused on housing, climate, and labor issues.

representatives.name: Niraj Antani
representatives.bio: Ohio State Senator. First Indian-American Republican elected to the Ohio legislature. Previously served in the Ohio House of Representatives.

representatives.name: Kevin Thomas
representatives.bio: New York State Senator. First Indian-American elected to the New York State Senate. Serves Long Island's 6th district.

representatives.name: Vin Gopal
representatives.bio: New Jersey State Senator representing Monmouth County. Indian-American business leader and community advocate.

representatives.name: Jay Chaudhuri
representatives.bio: North Carolina State Senator. First Asian-American elected to the NC Senate. Indian-American attorney focused on education and economic development.

representatives.name: Mujtaba Mohammed
representatives.bio: North Carolina State Senator representing Mecklenburg County. South Asian-American legislator.

representatives.name: Ram Villivalam
representatives.bio: Illinois State Senator. First Indian-American state senator in Illinois. Represents parts of Chicago's North Side.

representatives.name: Sam Singh
representatives.bio: Michigan State Senator. Indian-American legislator. Previously served in the Michigan House and as Mayor of East Lansing.

representatives.name: Manka Dhingra
representatives.bio: Washington State Senator. Indian-American prosecutor and mental health advocate. Her 2017 special election win flipped the WA Senate to Democratic control.

representatives.name: Kesha Ram Hinsdale
representatives.bio: Vermont State Senator. First woman of color elected to the Vermont State Senate. Of Indian and Afro-Caribbean heritage. Previously served in the Vermont House.

representatives.name: Saud Anwar
representatives.bio: Connecticut State Senator. South Asian-American physician and former Mayor of South Windsor. Focused on healthcare and public health policy.

representatives.name: MD Rahman
representatives.bio: Connecticut State Senator. South Asian-American legislator.

representatives.name: Kannan Srinivasan
representatives.bio: Virginia State Senator. Indian-American technology professional and community advocate.

representatives.name: Jeremy Cooney
representatives.bio: New York State Senator representing Rochester area. Of Indian heritage.

representatives.name: Raj Mukherji
representatives.bio: New Jersey State Senator. Indian-American attorney and public servant representing Jersey City and surrounding areas. Previously served in the NJ Assembly.

representatives.name: Nabeela Syed
representatives.bio: Illinois State Representative. At 23, became the youngest member of the Illinois General Assembly when elected in 2022. South Asian-American and Muslim-American trailblazer.

representatives.name: Padma Kuppa
representatives.bio: Michigan State Representative. First Indian-American and first Hindu to serve in the Michigan legislature. IT professional by background.

representatives.name: Ranjeev Puri
representatives.bio: Michigan State Representative. Indian-American legislator representing Canton area. Business executive by background.

representatives.name: Jenifer Rajkumar
representatives.bio: New York State Assembly Member. First South Asian American woman elected to the New York State Legislature. Led effort to make Diwali an official school holiday in New York.

representatives.name: Sarahana Shrestha
representatives.bio: New York State Assembly Member. Of Nepali origin. Climate and social justice advocate representing the Hudson Valley.

representatives.name: Anil Beephan Jr.
representatives.bio: New York State Assembly Member. Indian-American Republican legislator.

representatives.name: Salman Bhojani
representatives.bio: Texas State Representative. First Muslim member of the Texas Legislature. South Asian-American attorney representing Euless area.

representatives.name: Suleman Lalani
representatives.bio: Texas State Representative. Indian-American physician and community health advocate.

representatives.name: Arvind Venkat
representatives.bio: Pennsylvania State Representative. Indian-American emergency physician. First Indian-American elected to the Pennsylvania House.

representatives.name: Tarik Khan
representatives.bio: Pennsylvania State Representative. South Asian-American nurse and community health advocate.

representatives.name: Vandana Slatter
representatives.bio: Washington State Representative. First Indian-American elected to the Washington State Legislature. Pharmacist and healthcare policy advocate.

representatives.name: Kumar Barve
representatives.bio: Maryland State Delegate. One of the longest-serving Indian-American state legislators in the country. First Indian-American elected to a state legislature in the US (1990).

representatives.name: Harry Bhandari
representatives.bio: Maryland State Delegate. Of Nepali heritage. First Nepali-American elected to a state legislature in the US.

representatives.name: Jay Jalisi
representatives.bio: Maryland State Delegate. South Asian-American legislator.

representatives.name: Nima Kulkarni
representatives.bio: Kentucky State Representative. First Indian-American elected to the Kentucky legislature. Immigration attorney by profession.

representatives.name: Harry Arora
representatives.bio: Connecticut State Representative. Indian-American Republican legislator and businessman. Represents Greenwich area.

representatives.name: Raghib Allie-Brennan
representatives.bio: Connecticut State Representative. South Asian-American legislator.

representatives.name: Maryam Khan
representatives.bio: Connecticut State Representative. South Asian-American legislator.

representatives.name: Sujata Gadkar-Wilcox
representatives.bio: Connecticut State Representative. Indian-American constitutional law scholar and professor at Quinnipiac University.

representatives.name: Megan Srinivas
representatives.bio: Iowa State Representative. Indian-American physician and public health advocate. First Indian-American elected to the Iowa legislature.

representatives.name: Kevin Olickal
representatives.bio: Illinois State Representative. Indian-American legislator from the Chicago area.

representatives.name: Hanadi Nadeem
representatives.bio: Nevada State Assembly Member. South Asian-American legislator.

representatives.name: Reuben D'Silva
representatives.bio: Nevada State Assembly Member. Indian-American legislator and community advocate.

representatives.name: Ravi Bhalla
representatives.position: State Assembly Member / Former Mayor of Hoboken, NJ
representatives.bio: Sikh Indian-American politician. First Sikh mayor of Hoboken, NJ (2018-2025). Now in the NJ State Legislature.

representatives.name: Sadaf Jaffer
representatives.bio: New Jersey State Assembly Member. Former Mayor of Montgomery Township. First female South Asian-American mayor in the US. Princeton and Harvard educated.

representatives.name: Shama Haider
representatives.bio: New Jersey State Senator. South Asian-American legislator from Bergen County.

representatives.name: Sterley Stanley
representatives.bio: New Jersey State Assembly Member. Indian-American legislator representing Middlesex County (Edison area).

representatives.name: JJ Singh
representatives.bio: Virginia State Delegate. Indian-American legislator.

representatives.name: Anita Somani
representatives.bio: Ohio State Representative. Indian-American physician and first Indian-American woman in the Ohio legislature.

representatives.name: Jasmeet Bains
representatives.bio: California State Assembly Member. First Sikh and South Asian woman elected to the California Legislature. Physician representing Kern County.

representatives.name: Sabi Kumar
representatives.bio: Tennessee State Representative. Indian-American Republican and cardiovascular surgeon. First Indian-American elected to the Tennessee legislature.

representatives.name: Nithya Raman
representatives.position: LA City Council Member, District 4 (Running for Mayor 2026)
representatives.bio: Los Angeles City Council member and candidate for LA Mayor in the November 2026 runoff against incumbent Karen Bass. Born in India. Urban planner focused on housing and homelessness. Received 29% in the June 2026 primary, advancing to the general election.

representatives.name: Shahana Hanif
representatives.position: New York City Council Member, District 39
representatives.bio: First South Asian Muslim woman elected to the New York City Council. Represents Kensington, Borough Park, and Flatbush in Brooklyn. Bangladeshi-American community organizer.

representatives.name: Shekar Krishnan
representatives.position: New York City Council Member, District 25
representatives.bio: New York City Council Member representing Jackson Heights, Elmhurst, and Woodside in Queens. Indian-American civil rights attorney.

representatives.name: Dimple Ajmera
representatives.bio: Charlotte City Council Member At-Large. First South Asian-American elected to the Charlotte City Council. Indian-American businesswoman.

representatives.name: Aisha Chughtai
representatives.bio: Minneapolis City Council Member. South Asian-American progressive community leader.

representatives.name: Sukh Kaur
representatives.position: City Council Member, San Antonio, TX
representatives.bio: San Antonio City Council Member. Sikh Indian-American community leader.

representatives.name: Mohamed Khairullah
representatives.bio: Longest-serving mayor in Prospect Park history. South Asian-American Muslim community leader.

representatives.name: Neil Makhija
representatives.position: Chair, Montgomery County Board of Commissioners, PA
representatives.bio: Chair of the Montgomery County (PA) Board of Commissioners. First Indian-American to lead a county government in Pennsylvania. Voting rights attorney and co-founder of Indian American Impact.

representatives.name: Susheela Jayapal
representatives.bio: Multnomah County (Portland) Commissioner. Sister of Congresswoman Pramila Jayapal. Born in India. Attorney and community leader.

representatives.name: Nida Allam
representatives.position: Durham County Commissioner, NC (Running for U.S. House 2026)
representatives.bio: Durham County Commissioner and 2026 U.S. House candidate. First Muslim woman to hold elected office in North Carolina. South Asian-American community advocate.

representatives.name: Sim Gill
representatives.position: District Attorney, Salt Lake County, UT
representatives.bio: District Attorney for Salt Lake County, Utah. First Indian-American elected as a district attorney in the US. Born in India; Sikh heritage.

representatives.name: Manpreet Monica Singh
representatives.position: Judge, Harris County Civil Court, TX
representatives.bio: First female Sikh judge in the United States. Indian-American jurist in Houston, Texas.

representatives.name: KP George
representatives.position: County Judge, Fort Bend County, TX
representatives.bio: Fort Bend County Judge (top elected official in the county). First Indian-American and first person of South Asian descent to hold this role in Texas. Born in Kerala, India.

representatives.name: Shalina Kumar
representatives.position: Chief Judge, Oakland County Circuit Court, MI
representatives.bio: Chief Judge of Oakland County Circuit Court. First Indian-American circuit court judge in Michigan.

representatives.name: Nirav Shah
representatives.bio: 2026 candidate for Governor of Maine. Indian-American public health leader. Endorsed by Indian American Impact.

representatives.name: Pia Dandiya
representatives.bio: 2026 candidate for U.S. House in Connecticut. Indian-American. Endorsed by Indian American Impact.

representatives.name: Jay Vaingankar
representatives.bio: 2026 candidate for U.S. House in New Jersey. Indian-American. Endorsed by Indian American Impact.

representatives.name: Tina Shah
representatives.bio: 2026 candidate for U.S. House in New Jersey. Indian-American physician. Endorsed by Indian American Impact.

representatives.name: Vichal Kumar
representatives.bio: 2026 candidate for U.S. House in New York. Indian-American. Endorsed by Indian American Impact.

representatives.name: Lisa Kaul
representatives.bio: 2026 candidate for U.S. House in New York. Indian-American. Endorsed by Indian American Impact.
